title: REACH: An RL-based Hierarchical Humanoid Crawling Framework for Adaptable Confined Space Traversal
title_zh: REACH：一种基于强化学习的层次化人形机器人爬行框架，用于适应受限空间穿越
abstract: Humanoid locomotion in confined spaces requires continuous height adaptation across multiple locomotion modes, yet most existing approaches remain limited to height-adjustable bipedal walking. We present REACH, an RL-based hierarchical framework that enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to traverse height-constrained environments through variable-height bipedal walking and crawling. The learned policies regulate body height over complementary command ranges of 1.27--0.50m in bipedal locomotion and 0.50--0.20m in crawling, extending traversal beyond the clearance limits of crouched walking. To address contact-rich crawling dynamics, we employ a history-conditioned latent representation that captures terrain and interaction context from proprioceptive observations. A bidirectional transition policy further connects crouched bipedal locomotion and crawling across large kinematic and contact discontinuities. These skills are integrated with a LiDAR-based planner that converts point clouds into collision-free three-dimensional paths and locomotion commands, including proactive height targets. Real-world experiments demonstrate accurate height and velocity tracking, robust terrain traversal, reliable mode transitions and confined-space traversal with the proposed pipeline. Code and videos are available at https://aislab-sustech.github.io/REACH/.
abstract_zh: 人形机器人在受限空间中的运动需要跨多种运动模式连续调整高度，然而现有方法大多局限于高度可调的双足行走。我们提出 REACH，一个基于强化学习的层次化框架，使 Unitree G1 人形机器人能够通过可变高度双足行走和爬行穿越高度受限环境。学习到的策略在双足运动 1.27--0.50 米和爬行 0.50--0.20 米的互补指令范围内调节身体高度，将穿越能力扩展到蹲伏行走的净空限制之外。为解决接触丰富的爬行动力学问题，我们采用历史条件潜在表示，从本体感觉观测中捕捉地形和交互上下文。双向过渡策略进一步连接蹲伏双足运动和爬行，跨越大的运动学和接触不连续性。这些技能与基于 LiDAR 的规划器集成，该规划器将点云转换为无碰撞的三维路径和运动指令，包括主动高度目标。真实世界实验证明了精确的高度和速度跟踪、鲁棒的地形穿越、可靠的模式转换以及使用所提流程的受限空间穿越。代码和视频见 https://aislab-sustech.github.io/REACH/。
tldr_zh: REACH 框架让人形机器人通过行走和爬行穿越受限空间。
cover_zh: 人形机器人还能爬着走？REACH 框架让受限空间穿越不再难
